annotations.title: Invite candidates to an interview or position

description:
[Interviews] Invite candidates to an interview or position: e-mails each one their invitation.

The same invitation the admin console's Add candidates sends: creates or
finds the candidate, uses the company's invitation budget, and queues the
invitation e-mail (with the optional recruiter message). Each row comes
back with its outcome; only 'Invited' means an e-mail was queued.

With send_email=false NOTHING is e-mailed: each candidate is registered and
their personal interview_url comes back; nothing is sent. The result's
email_sent says which happened. send_email=false sends nothing now or later: no
invitation, no reminders, no SMS or WhatsApp, and it does not use the invitation
budget.

A draft interview is not refused, but candidates can use their links only once
it is active; activating it is a separate step (set_interview_state).
is_test=true (with send_email=false) gives test links that also work on a draft,
for trying the interview yourself; they are not for candidates, whose results
would be marked as tests.

email.description: The candidate's e-mail address; the invitation goes here.

phone.description: Optional mobile number in international format (+421903123456) for SMS / WhatsApp notifications.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

interview_id.description: The interview or position: its `id` from list_interviews, or the interview_def_set_id create_interview returned.

is_test.description: Only with send_email=false: test links for trying the interview yourself; they also work on a draft. Not for real candidates: their results are marked as tests.

language.description: Language code for new candidates (e.g. 'en', 'sk'); defaults to English.

llm_model.description: Your model id, e.g. "claude-opus-4-8"; "unknown" if unsure. For analytics.

merchant_id.description: Only for an account acting for a sub-merchant; omit for your own company.

message_from_recruiter.description: Optional personal note shown above the invitation in the e-mail.

send_email.description: true (default): e-mail each candidate their invitation. false: send NOTHING; register them and return each one's personal interview_url, shared outside this tool.
